sections.heading: Energy Performance and Modern Glazing Options
sections.body: Older commercial windows can be a significant source of thermal transfer, contributing to uncomfortable interior temperatures and elevated HVAC loads. Modern insulated glass units and thermally broken framing systems are designed to reduce heat gain in summer and heat loss in winter, helping building systems work more efficiently. While specific performance outcomes vary depending on the building, orientation, and existing conditions, upgrading to contemporary glazing products is widely recognized as a meaningful improvement to building envelope performance. Our team can walk you through available glass options, including low-emissivity coatings and dual-pane configurations, so you can make an informed decision that aligns with your property's performance goals and budget. We serve buildings throughout the Tysons area and the broader Northern Virginia, Washington DC, and Maryland region.
